sections.title: about
sections.text:
Positive is an attitude. Positive is a photographic term.

Positive is a small company that provides professional photo and video services.

Positive are young academically educated photographers, cameramen, editors, sound engineers, designers.

A positive can respond quickly to all your needs and ideas. Positive nurtures an individual approach to each client. Positive provides types of services tailored to every expectation.
